edges.reason: msg.sender used in the constructor to set creator, the deployer balance, corda and chopper flags.
randomItIs mixes msg.sender into the pseudo-random seed, making the outcome caller-influenced.
block.timestamp (now) is read by randomItIs as randomness entropy, creating a timestamp dependency.
now is hashed together with msg.sender and brown to derive the 'random' value, a timestamp-dependency weakness.
msg.sender is part of the hash input for the pseudo-random value used to blacklist recipients.
SetBurnAddress has no onlyOwner modifier, so any external caller reaches the ownership mutation.
SetBurnAddress performs the unguarded write _owner = alcoho that hijacks contract ownership.
alcoho is read as the destination of the unguarded ownership reassignment.

SomethingMaybe creates tokens by calling the internal _mint.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient argument of transfer is forwarded unchanged into _transfer, where the whitelist write happens.
amount argument of transfer is forwarded into _transfer and checked against ship.
sender argument of transferFrom becomes the sender of the internal _transfer.
recipient argument of transferFrom becomes the recipient of the internal _transfer.
amount argument of transferFrom is both transferred and deducted from the allowance.
spender argument of approve is used as the allowance key inside _approve.
amount argument of approve is stored, or replaced by 22823, inside _approve.
spender argument is the mapping key written by the Netflix owner function.
val argument is written straight into the corda whitelist mapping.
val2 argument is written straight into the chopper blacklist mapping.
amount argument of SomethingMaybe is passed to _mint to create new supply.
amount argument of the onlyOwner BurnThePool directly becomes the global sell threshold ship.
sender argument controls the creator check, corda check and the ship limit inside _transfer.
recipient argument controls the corda/chopper blacklist writes inside _transfer.
amount argument is bounded by ship and moved between balances inside _transfer.
amount argument is added to the balance and to _totalSupply inside _mint.
newOwner argument is validated and stored into _owner by _transferOwnership.
spender argument of increaseAllowance selects the allowance entry rewritten by _approve.
addedValue argument is summed into the allowance stored by _approve.
spender argument of decreaseAllowance selects the allowance entry rewritten by _approve.
subtractedValue argument is deducted from the allowance stored by _approve.
local tok only exists to hold the value that _approve writes into _allowances.
local screen only holds the timestamp-derived modulo value returned by randomItIs.
